schedule.label: notice of adjudication by
schedule.basis: no adjudication of a subcontract if notice is given more than 90 days after the earliest of the listed dates (2026-04-10), unless the parties agree otherwise

disclaimer: Administrative reminder, not legal advice - verify with counsel.
applicability: Contracts/procurements that started before July 1, 2018 stay under the old Act (Construction Act s.87.3(1)).
Prompt-payment and adjudication Parts do not apply to contracts entered into before Oct 1, 2019 (Construction Act s.87.3(4)).
